description: One domain decays, with a 30-day half-life measured from created_at: one half-life old ranks on half its stored confidence, two half-lives on a quarter, and its Confidence component reports the stored value as undecayedValue. A created_at in the future (clock skew) decays nothing but still reports undecayedValue. Domains match ordinally ("Framework-API" is not listed), and a record with no domain does not decay: their undecayedValue is null.
